purpose: W9-D: implement server-authoritative business calendars, deadline/pause/resume/escalation instances and governed ExceptionCase/two-person manual resolution without fabricating external finality or bypassing domain command authority.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.
requiredInvariants: BusinessCalendar, DeadlineRule and DeadlineInstance are server-authoritative, versioned and source-bound. Client clocks/timers cannot create expiry, breach or extension authority.
Calendar supports working/non-working days, timezone, cutoffs and exceptional calendar versions. Historical deadlines pin the calendar/rule version used at creation.
Pause/resume is explicit, reasoned and source-linked. Paused duration and recalculated dueAt are deterministic; a hidden status change cannot silently stop or reset SLA time.

EscalationRule versions declare breach thresholds, recipients/roles, required notification/event and optional higher-level deadline. Escalation is evidence, not an automatic domain approval/rejection unless that domain separately declares the transition.

ExceptionCase records the blocked object/action, reason, requested exception, evidence, requester, policy version and allowed resolution actions. It cannot bypass a hard legal/regulatory/security invariant that the pinned policy marks non-overridable.
Two-person resolution requires distinct current authorized memberships for proposer/approver when policy requires it. One user, one membership or one compromised session cannot satisfy both roles.
Manual override/resolution appends an immutable decision with exact scope/expiry/reason/evidence. It never rewrites the original blocker, source facts or prior decision history.
External-system outage may pause/extend only those deadlines whose policy explicitly permits that outage reason and source-health evidence. It cannot fabricate external receipt/finality.
Deadline/exception actions revalidate current tenant/organization/membership/role/job-profile authority before mutation and before replay.
Same-tenant outsiders and cross-tenant actors cannot inspect private exceptions/evidence/deadlines outside source-object or staff authority.
Every mutation commits aggregate version, immutable event, audit and outbox atomically with payload-bound idempotency/CAS; evidence failure rolls back acceptance.
Notification center receives escalation/reminder events but cannot determine deadline state itself. Domain commands consume deadline/exception decisions through explicit source ids/versions.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, domain state machines, external provider claims and REG.RU topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Domain/PostgreSQL tests prove calendar/timezone/working-day/cutoff computation, version pinning, pause/resume and deterministic breach/escalation.
Changing a calendar/rule creates new future behavior without rewriting historical DeadlineInstance dueAt/breach evidence unless an explicit versioned adjustment command is accepted.
Exception tests prove hard non-overridable blockers remain blocked and policy-allowed exceptions require exact evidence/scope/expiry.
Two-person tests reject same membership/user, revoked approver, stale authority and concurrent double-approval races.
External outage tests require current source-health evidence and only affect explicitly permitted deadlines; no fake external success appears.
Cross-tenant/same-tenant outsider access, stale version and changed-payload replay fail closed.
Audit/outbox/event failure leaves no accepted pause/exception/approval/breach transition.
Exact-head CI/review plus REG.RU clock/calendar/worker/restart and real operator exception acceptance remain required before terminal credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Each business domain must explicitly bind relevant deadlines/exceptions rather than a generic engine mutating domain state.
W9-C notification delivery consumes reminders/escalations after both scopes are accepted.
Real external source-health/outage evidence depends on W7/W6 provider readiness.
Human two-person operational acceptance on REG.RU remains mandatory.
